name: nusajs-monorepo
description: Workspace for the NusaJS web framework.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && tsc --build --force tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @nusajs/core typecheck
scripts.deps:check: pnpm run deps:audit && pnpm run deps:licenses
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run deps:check
